capabilities: Pick a note by navigating into and out of folders
Insert a link at the cursor, replacing selected text
Rank candidates deterministically (exact, prefix, path, scattered)
Define named pickers rooted at a specific folder
Return the picked link as a string to templates, scripts or other plugins
extras: Documentation is itself a demo vault shipped with every release; the plugin is in the official Community Plugins repository, with BRAT for beta versions. Folder-note aliases are read from an existing folder-notes setup rather than configured here.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's own link autocomplete searches the whole vault and ranks it fuzzily, which is exactly wrong
motivation: The author found vault-wide fuzzy autocomplete unhelpful when you already know which folder the link belongs in and want the same note to rank first every time.
problem: Obsidian's built-in link autocomplete searches the whole vault with fuzzy ranking, so the wanted note is not reliably first and there is no way to narrow the search to one folder.

relations.evidence: Different action: inserts links; navigates by folder
Overlaps on picking; folder navigation with ..; fixed ranking; script returns a link string
Narrower targets: vault notes; inserts Obsidian links rather than filesystem paths

summary: Folder-navigating link picker that inserts a link to a note with deterministic ranking, callable from commands, templates or scripts.
